name: vwap_anchored_support_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, the previous session's VWAP is the single most-tracked institutional benchmark — every VWAP-algorithm-driven fund evaluates their intraday P&L against yesterday's VWAP before initiating new directional positions. When NIFTY drifts to within 0.15% of the prior session's VWAP during the current day, institutional order clusters form: VWAP-lagging algos begin accumulating (support), while VWAP-beating algos reduce exposure (resistance). The first clean cross of this level — confirmed by a volume surge showing order-flow acceleration and a neutral RSI (40-62) indicating neither side has yet overwhelmed the other — resolves into a 15-25 spot-point impulse within the next 30-90 seconds.
core_signal_oneliner: Clean cross of prior session VWAP within 0.15% proximity, confirmed by volume surge and neutral RSI (38-62)
